Dabbe me kya-kya?

Ek dabba, poora khana

Har dabbe me hota hai — 3 sabziyon me se aapki pasand ki 2 sabzi, tandoori aur tawa chapati ka mix, chawal aur dal. Pet bhi bharta hai, dil bhi.

2 Sabzi — Aapki Pasand

Har din 3 sabziyon ka option — Aloo Gobi, Bhindi Masala, Mix Veg. Unme se koi 2 chunein.

Chapati — Tandoori + Tawa

Ek tandoori ki khushboo, ek tawa ki narmi — ya dono ek hi type ki. Aap decide karein.

Chawal

Khile hue steamed chawal, ya jeera ka tadka laga khushboodar jeera rice.

Dal

Ghar wali arhar dal fry, ya upar se desi ghee ka tadka — protein aur swad dono.

Sabzi chunein, chapati ka mix chunein — price saath-saath live badalta rahega. Pasand aaye to ek tap me WhatsApp par order ho jayega.

Aksar poochhe jaane wale sawal

Dabbe me exactly kya-kya aata hai?

3 sabziyon me se aapki chuni hui 2 sabzi, 2 chapati (tawa/tandoori mix), chawal aur dal. Base dabba ₹120 ka hai; tandoori chapati, jeera rice aur ghee tadka dal jaise upgrades ke saath ₹160 tak jata hai.

Weekly plan beech me pause kar sakte hain?

Ha, bilkul. Chhutti, tour ya exam — WhatsApp par ek message karke pause kar dein. Pause wale dinon ka paisa aage ke dabbo me adjust ho jata hai, kabhi waste nahi hota.

Payment kaise karna hai?

Delivery par cash/UPI, ya Ghar Ka Khana Wallet se. Wallet me ek baar paisa add karein, phir har dabba apne aap kat jayega — roz payment ki tension khatam.

Loyalty points kaise kaam karte hain?

Har dabbe par plan ke hisab se 10–20 points milte hain. 100 points = 1 dabba bilkul FREE. Points WhatsApp par kabhi bhi check kar sakte hain.

Order karne ka sabse easy tareeka?

Upar dabba customize karke WhatsApp button dabayein, ya seedha +91 83085 00306 par call/WhatsApp karein. Lunch ke liye subah 10 baje tak order karein.

Contact

Koi sawal? Bas ek call door hai

Order, plan, delivery area ya koi bhi query — call ya WhatsApp karein, hum turant jawab dete hain. Timing: Subah 8 baje – Raat 9 baje, har din.
